title: Medium Expense Approval
purpose: First official medium scenario showing resumable orchestration and branching after an external approval event.
businessStory: A team submits an expense that persists immediately, waits for review, and later resumes after an approval event arrives.
walkthrough: Run the sample through the Step 50 one-command trial path.
Submit an expense payload to start the process.
Capture the returned correlation id or execution context.
Publish the approval event using the provided sample payload structure.
Inspect the trace before and after resume to understand the orchestration.
Run the golden slice gate to verify the panel action and procedure path both route through the Concept Gateway.
expectedOutcomes: The expense enters a waiting state after submission.
A later event resumes the execution using correlation information.
The branch outcome can be inspected through traces and runtime state.
The supported panel action resolves to SubmitExpenseProcedure and the procedure saves through the Concept Gateway.
